content: Our paper "Tool Condition Monitoring in CNC Systems: A hybrid computer vision and signal processing approach" has been accepted for publication in The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology (Q1).

I have completed the MathWorks Parallel Computing Workshop, that was hold as a cooperation by MathWorks, KDP and Sciengineer in budapest. Hands-on experience with parallel computing techniques in MATLAB to optimize performance for large-scale computations was gained.
The initial version of our dataset, ELTE-TCM-46k, has been published on Hugging Face!

Awarded 2nd Place at the University Scientific Student Association (TDK) conference in the Informatics section, qualifying for the National OTDK. The research focused on CNC tool monitoring and was selected for publication.
